scripts.test:backend: node --test backend/test/apiRoutes.test.js backend/test/demoTrialService.test.js backend/test/trialLifecycleService.test.js backend/test/iotProtocol.test.js backend/test/operationalDefaults.test.js backend/test/simulador.test.js
scripts.verify:sensor: npm run test:iot && npm run firmware:check && node --check backend/routes/api.js
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:mobile: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend -- --host 0.0.0.0" "npm run start --prefix mobile"
scripts.dev:simulador: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run simulador --prefix backend"
scripts.check: npm run check:repo && node --check backend/routes/api.js && node --check backend/server.js && node --check backend/config/db.js && node --check backend/simulador.js && npm run test:backend && npm run test --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.predeploy: npm run check:env && npm run check
